hardware_note: This build has not run on a board. The previous build (double-precision FFT, 623,984 bytes) ran on the owner board on 26 Nov 2026: it passed REPLAY and SELFTEST and captured audio, but its feature step took about 957 ms per one-second window, the I2S queue overflowed and every window was reset. This build moves features and inference to a second task (core 1), uses a single-precision FFT with a precomputed twiddle table, normalises features once and enlarges the DMA queue to 32 descriptors. Agreement with the earlier double-precision build: 1377 of 1377 labels, max log-mel difference 0.00347, max logit difference 0.000135 (tests/float_parity.py).
